summary: Sprint 7B.2 Copy Execution Engine — 22/22 backend pytest cases PASS. Verified: /meta defaults (max_daily_loss=10, max_drawdown=20, max_open_trades=10, equity_protection=30, mode=multiplier), broker=paper, trader_count=28, simulator.enabled=true. MasterSimulator confirmed running — hana_tanaka (Scalper) master trades observed via /master-trades. Full copy lifecycle for fresh signed-up user (start with multiplier+multiplier=1.5+max_open_trades=3 → update to multiplier=2.0/max_daily_loss=15 → pause → resume → stop) all persisted correctly. Event-driven fan-out verified: admin /simulation/force-open triggers a follower mirror trade within ~1-3s (not polling); /simulation/force-close correctly propagates to close all mirrored follower trades with pnl_usd populated. All three execution modes verified: multiplier (2.0 × master_lot within clamp), fixed_lot (≈0.5), equity_percent (respecting min_lot=0.01 clamp on small computed size). /my/summary returns all required fields (total_pnl_usd, today_pnl_usd, today_trades, open_positions, active_copies, paused_copies, halted_copies, total_trades, win_rate_pct). /my/copies enrichment returns .live{open_positions, lifetime_pnl_usd, today_pnl_usd, starting_equity_usd, current_equity_usd} and .trader{name, avatar_url, style}. Bulk ops pause-all/resume-all/close-all all worked as expected. Admin controls: /admin/simulation/status returns active_traders≈28, /pause+/resume toggle enabled flag, /speed persists, /admin/config get+put defaults roundtrip. Regression clean: /auth/me, /wallet, /notifications, /forex/symbols, /market/dashboard all 200.
critical_code_review_comments: Event-driven fan-out CONFIRMED — EventBus.subscribe(TRADE_OPENED) in CopyEngine.__init__ fires within milliseconds of MasterSimulator.publish(); follower mirror trades appear ~1-3s after force-open (round-trip through mongo insert + notification). No polling loop in engine.py.
engine._mirror_close correctly closes ALL follower trades matching master_id regardless of user, using asyncio.gather — clean fan-out on TRADE_CLOSED.

engine._compute_lot correctly implements all three modes with min/max clamping (min_lot_size=0.01, max_lot_size=5.0). Equity_percent formula: (equity * pct/100) / 100_000 * max(1, master_lot) — for $10k starting equity + 2% + master_lot~0.3, computed lot ≈ 0.0006 → clamped to min_lot 0.01. Test asserted the clamp behaviour and passed.

engine._check_risk_halts enforces max_open_trades (skip, no halt), max_daily_loss_pct (halt + auto_pause_on_daily_loss), max_drawdown_pct (halt), equity_protection_pct (halt + close all). Risk protection code path executes before broker call — good ordering.
config.py CopyConfig cache is invalidated correctly on update_defaults / update_sim via self._cache = None — no stale defaults.
MasterSimulator._trader_loop uses asyncio startup jitter (1-8s) so 28 traders don't fire simultaneously — good.
MasterSimulator.status() returns active_traders by counting non-done tasks — reliable proxy for simulator health.
PaperBroker (broker.py) inserts to copy_follower_trades with pnl calc on close — verified pnl_usd populated in test.
routes.py cleanly separates public / /my / /admin scopes. Admin routes gated by get_current_admin dependency — confirmed 401/403 without token.
MongoDB _id excluded via {"_id": 0} projection consistently across engine.get_settings, list_copies, follower_trades, master trades, admin config — no ObjectId leaks.
engine.py at 470 lines and simulator.py at 265 lines both under 700-line threshold. routes.py 278 lines. Clean modular split.
Sprint 7B.2 default max_daily_loss_pct=10 confirmed in /meta AND persisted correctly in admin config get/put roundtrip test.
seed_data_creation: Fresh user created via POST /api/auth/signup with random email/mobile each run (e.g. copytest_<8chars>@mfb.in / mobile 9xxxxxxxxx / password Test@1234). No admin config drift — max_daily_loss_pct restored to original after PUT test.

Follower trade appears ~1-3s after force-open, so 20s deadline is generous.
rca_of_issue: No blocking issues. Sprint 7B.2 Copy Execution Engine is fully wired and functional. Event-driven mirroring confirmed working (asyncio EventBus subscribe/publish, not polling). All modes, risk protection knobs, bulk ops, admin controls, and regression endpoints pass.
